single: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a clean single-object reference for image-to-3D reconstruction of the ApocalypseRV bunker bunk bed. Produce one realistic PBR product render of a two-tier industrial steel bunk bed, overall length 2.00m, height 1.85m, depth 0.90m. Four perfectly straight upright square-section steel corner posts. Two parallel rectangular mattress frames at matching heights on all four corners, exactly level and perpendicular to the posts. Thin flat stained muted gray mattresses; ONE small loosely folded blanket lying on lower mattress, no hanging cloth. A straight ladder attached at the front right. Subtle chipped gray paint and restrained rust; low saturation industrial horror, but intact rectilinear structure. Camera: level eye-height at the center of the object's height, zero roll, zero elevation, modest 25-degree yaw from the long front side to show some right end; 20-degree horizontal FOV / long lens weak perspective. All vertical posts vertical in the picture, straight lines, parallel levels. Full object including all four feet visible and centered with generous 10% clear margin; no cropping. Transparent background, no floor, no cast shadow, no surroundings, no people. Soft even studio illumination. No text, labels, dimensions, watermark, dramatic perspective, isometric view, top-down camera, tilted bed, bent metal or damaged frame.
multi: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: image-to-3D multi-view reference, one horizontal three-panel turnaround sheet, aspect ratio exactly 3:1, 3072x1024 ideal. Input image is the design reference for the SAME industrial bunk bed, not a view to repeat. Render the exact same bed in THREE equally sized SQUARE panels, ordered LEFT TO RIGHT: FRONT long side with ladder, LEFT narrow end (camera rotated exactly 90 degrees around bed), BACK opposite long side (camera rotated 180 degrees). Camera in ALL panels is level at center height, elevation 0 degrees, roll 0, horizontal FOV 20 degrees, same camera distance and same physical pixel scale. NOT isometric, NOT three quarter, NOT looking down. Four corner posts perfectly straight and upright, rectangular mattress supports level, rectangular 90 degree joints. Physical dimensions length 2m, height1.85m, depth0.90m. Front and back panels show the long horizontal 2m width; middle end panel is visibly narrower 0.90m wide but has the SAME 1.85m height, do NOT enlarge it to fill panel width. Object center and foot height align exactly across all panels, maximum wide side occupies about 85% of square panel width, generous margin. Keep identical post heights, two mattress heights and thicknesses, ladder permanently on front right, single small folded blanket on lower bed, chipped gray paint and subtle rust. The left end has matching horizontal end guard rails, no new ladder. Soft even studio lighting. Background must be transparent in all panels and between views, no floor, no cast shadows, no text or labels, no panel lines, no grid, no dimensions, no people or surroundings. Crucial: all 3 views must be geometrically consistent with one rigid bed, shared scale and framing; four feet lie on one flat plane.
